text: Driver decision on RES-003 (research-review 0): the shared calendar entry christ-the-king stays unchanged in this run, so research takes the finding's second branch. Reason: src/sources/calendars/roman-1962/propers.yaml records as an open item that the file has no way to say when a proper is said (seasonal substitutions are stated in prose notes), so encoding the Tract's votive-after-Septuagesima condition is a schema and tooling change rather than a data correction, and adding the paschal Alleluia as an unconditional proper would replicate the same defect in the reader. The calendar condition is left to its owner.
